UKHC010144272025
BA1/1722/2025
Ravi Kumar Alias Gautam Kumar
--Applicant
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand --Respondent
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Girish Chandra Lakhchaura, learned 
counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. Vijay Khanduri, learned Brief Holder 
for the State.
3. The medical report does not reveal that 
there is any sexual assault with the victim and 
only on the statement of the victim recorded 
under Section 180/183 of BNSS 2023 charge sheet 
has been filed, even the Doctor who conducted 
the medical examination have not given any 
opinion with regard to sexual assault including 
rape.
4. Now the question is on what material 
charge sheet has been filed.
5. Put up this matter on 09.07.2026.
6. In the meantime, State Counsel may get 
definite instructions failing which the I.O. 
concerned shall remain present to explain on 
what material he has filed the charge sheet in 
absence of any medical report.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
07-07-2026
Parul

UKHC010144272025
BA1/1722/2025
Ravi Kumar Alias Gautam Kumar
--Applicant
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand --Respondent
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Girish Chandra Lakhchaura, learned 
counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. B.C. Joshi, learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. As per the medical report, which the I.O. 
placed before this Court the hymen is found 
ruptured though no definite opinion with regard 
to the sexual assault has been given by the 
Doctor. The I.O. apprise to this Court that there 
are in total 10 prosecution witnesses out of which 
two prosecution witnesses have already been 
examined.
4. It is argued that the applicant is 
languishing in jail since August 2025. It is also 
submitted that the complete medical report was 
not annexed along with the counter affidavit.
5. Let medical report be supplied to the 
learned counsel for the applicant so that he may 
gone through with that and then address.
6. Put up this matter on 05.08.2026.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
09-07-2026
